assumption_incompatibility_audit.cohort_unit_rejection_diagnostic: Boundary 'fraud_to_call_center_v1' unit/cohort mismatch on 'call_center_arrivals': upstream exported 'calls_from_all_declines_including_fraud_per_step', contract requires 'calls_from_legit_false_declines_per_step'.

temporal_desync_audit.finding: Batch boundary synchronization (cadence=3 steps) delays shift detection across the fraud->call-center boundary, causing extra SLA breaches and utility loss.

negative_findings.title: Asynchronous Boundary Cadence Degrades Shift Response
negative_findings.summary: Coupling the Fraud and Call-Center models across a 3-step batch boundary incurs $4,435.34 in post-shift utility loss and 1.00 additional SLA breach steps compared to synchronous 1-step integration.

negative_findings.title: Composition Adds Specification & Runtime Overhead With Zero Regret Gain When Co-Located
negative_findings.summary: Decomposing the 2-department cascade into separate submodels increases specification elements by +45.5% (16 vs 11) and achieves $0.00 decision-regret improvement over the monolithic model.

negative_findings.title: Small Upstream Calibration Bias Amplifies Nonlinearly Across Queue Boundaries
negative_findings.summary: A 5.3% upstream call-rate bias amplifies by 1.96x into a 10.4% downstream wait-time error ($28,206.02 cash MAE) when the downstream call-center operates near saturation.

line2_swe_ecosystem.hypothesis_statement: Under burst concurrency and runtime configuration shifts (K_t), an integrated dynamic model of structural dependencies + shared resource contention + bitemporal telemetry improves cross-service change-impact prediction and deployment planning over static graphs, while static graphs and historical ML remain superior for compile-time breaks and routine stationary test selection.

ladder_results.rung_name: Rung 3: ML + Static Graph Centrality Features
Rung 4: Dynamic Simulator Without Config K_t or Causal Gate
Rung 5: Experimental SWE World Model (State + Config K_t + Evidence Gate)

ablation_results.removed_component: Stateful DB connection-pool & retry-storm contention dynamics
ablation_results.finding: Without stateful connection-pool contention, the model reverts to static-graph reachability, missing the cross-service `payment_worker` outage.
Without runtime context K_t, the simulator assumes baseline flag/retry settings and fails to predict the flag-triggered retry storm.

ablation_results.removed_component: DependencyEvidenceNature query gate on telemetry correlations
ablation_results.finding: Without evidence-nature gating, high correlation between `payment_worker` DLQ alerts and `orders_db` latency is misdiagnosed as a `payment_worker` bug.

ablation_results.removed_component: Bitemporal `as_of(t)` filter on delayed postmortem & DLQ records
ablation_results.finding: Disabling `BitemporalLedger.as_of(5.0)` leaks 2 future records (postmortem root-cause confirmation at t=10.0), creating illusory offline accuracy.

negative_findings_and_transfer_limits.title: Static Dependency Graph Wins Pure Compile/Schema API-Break Detection
negative_findings_and_transfer_limits.summary: For deterministic compile-time signature or protobuf schema breaks with no concurrency or runtime config interaction, Rung 1 (Static Dependency Graph) achieves F1 = 1.000 with 1 specification component vs. 10 for Rung 5. An EWM is unnecessary and not cost-justified for static dependency analysis.

negative_findings_and_transfer_limits.title: Historical ML Matches or Beats EWM on Routine Unit-Test Selection Under Stationary Config
negative_findings_and_transfer_limits.summary: When runtime feature flags and concurrency load are stationary, Rung 3 (GBT on historical co-change + static graph centrality) achieves 0.950 recall on routine unit-test regressions vs. 0.920 for Rung 5 at 3.3x lower specification cost.

negative_findings_and_transfer_limits.title: Enterprise Stock-and-Flow Conservation Laws Do NOT Transfer to Discrete Logic Bugs
negative_findings_and_transfer_limits.summary: Unlike financial ledgers or physical inventory where linear conservation (A * dx = 0) holds, discrete software logic bugs (off-by-one errors, null dereferences, race conditions) do not obey stoichiometric conservation. The EWM architecture transfers ONLY to bounded operational resources (connection pools, thread queues, rate limits, progressive delivery), NOT to semantic program verification.
